rows.commons_title: File:Tilma de San Juan Diego (Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe).jpg
rows.label_en: Original Guadalupe tilma in the New Basilica
rows.label_fr: Tilma originale de Guadalupe dans la nouvelle basilique
rows.alt_en: Guadalupe's original Marian image framed above the basilica altar, partly obscured by a large Mexican national flag in the foreground
rows.alt_fr: Image mariale originale de Guadalupe, encadrée au-dessus de l’autel de la basilique et partiellement masquée par un grand drapeau mexicain au premier plan
rows.caption_en: The image venerated as the original tilma of Our Lady of Guadalupe, photographed at the New Basilica in 2013. A Mexican flag partially obscures the lower view; this is not an isolated close-up of the image.
rows.caption_fr: L’image vénérée comme la tilma originale de Notre-Dame de Guadalupe, photographiée dans la nouvelle basilique en 2013. Un drapeau mexicain masque partiellement la partie basse ; il ne s’agit pas d’un gros plan isolé de l’image.
rows.rights_review: Original Marian image dates to the sixteenth century; original photographic composition credited by Commons to Juan Carlos Fonseca Mata under CC BY-SA 4.0. Flag is modern ordinary national symbol, not a separate authored artwork requiring license for incidental depiction.

rows.label_en: Original Magna Mater Austriae at Mariazell
rows.label_fr: Magna Mater Austriae originale de Mariazell
rows.alt_en: Venerated Madonna and Child image dressed in a rose-coloured robe within the ornate silver-and-gold Altar of Grace at Mariazell
rows.alt_fr: Image vénérée de la Vierge à l’Enfant vêtue d’une robe rose, dans le riche autel de Grâce argenté et doré à Mariazell
rows.caption_en: The original venerated Magna Mater Austriae at Mariazell’s central Altar of Grace, photographed in 2017. The medieval wooden figure is dressed in a devotional robe; this photograph does not expose the underlying carving in full.
rows.caption_fr: La Magna Mater Austriae originale vénérée à l’autel de Grâce central de Mariazell, photographiée en 2017. La statue médiévale en bois est revêtue d’une robe de dévotion ; la photographie ne montre pas toute la sculpture sous-jacente.
rows.rights_review: The image depicts the original medieval Marian figure at Mariazell (the basilica's official history places its veneration from medieval times). Modern photo author Launus published this file under CC BY-SA 4.0. It does not require permission for any twentieth-century sculpture.
